title: Soft landscaping minimum 15% of the site
text: Landscaping. C1.2.1 Development to provide a minimum 15% soft landscaping per site with a minimum dimension of 1m (refer Figure 1.2a). C1.2.6 The soft landscaping percentage of C1.2.1 may be reduced to 10% where a significant existing tree is retained on site. Note: a retained tree replaces the tree planting provision in C1.2.4 on a like-for-like basis.

exceptions.label: C1.2.6 significant existing tree retained on site: soft landscaping reduced to 10%

replaces.note: no site-wide soft landscaping requirement for grouped R25 and below in Part B
tree-retention reduction to 10% now C1.2.6; new for R25 and below (ch3-014)

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

verified.note: Values (15%, 1m; 10% with a retained significant tree, C1.2.6 on p12) check. 'Per site' does not say whether a grouped development is tested per dwelling site or across the whole development; Figure 1.2a shows several dwellings without settling it (ch3-009).

notes: diverges: the tree-retention reduction is C1.2.6 in Chapter 3 (p12; C1.2.4 in Chapter 2), so the exception label and source are renumbered; the test is unchanged. Soft landscape per A1 (300 mm soil, in-ground planting, turf; excludes permeable paving and planter boxes). 'Per site' for a grouped dwelling reads as the dwelling's site (A1 exclusive-use area); whether 15% is tested per dwelling or across the development is ambiguous (ch3-009). R100-SL: C1.2.1-r100sl.
